description: Use this when the user wants a metronome, online metronome, 120 bpm metronome, tap tempo or a metronome for practice. Opens a live beat widget with 20 to 400 quarter-note BPM, 1 to 16 beats per bar, accents, subdivisions and an optional ramp with up to 1000 tempo stages. Reports milliseconds per beat and subdivision. The widget runs only while on screen; audio timing depends on the device. Does not record audio or detect pitch.

accent_pattern.description: One level per beat: 0 silent (including its subdivisions), 1 normal, 2 accented. Defaults to an accented first beat. Example: [2,1,1,1].

beat_unit.description: Time signature denominator. Default 4. BPM remains quarter-note BPM. Example: 8 for 6/8.

beats_per_bar.description: Time signature numerator, 1 to 16. Default 4. Example: 6 for 6/8.

bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 120.

ramp.description: Optional bar-based ramp; start must match bpm. The target then holds. Example: {start_bpm:80,end_bpm:120,bars_per_step:4,bpm_per_step:5}.

bars_per_step.description: Completed bars before changing tempo. Example: 4.

bpm_per_step.description: Positive BPM change; direction follows start and end. Up to three decimal places. Example: 5.

end_bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 120.

start_bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 80.

subdivision.description: Clicks per signature beat: none=1, eighths=2, triplets=3, sixteenths=4. Default none. Example: eighths.

name: show_metronome
title: Show metronome
